2608.29588.title: Call Neighbours Yourself: Graph Walks with Destination-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation
2608.29588.paper_summary: Reasoning over text-attributed graphs (TAGs) requires large language models (LLMs) to combine a node's text with evidence distributed across its neighbourhood. Existing methods fix the set of accessible neighbours before generation, forcing reasoning to operate over a static context and preventing the model from acquiring missing evidence during inference. We argue that neighbour selection should itself be part of the reasoning process. To this end, we propose Call Neighbours Yourself (CNY), a framework that enables LLMs to proactively explore graph neighbourhoods through topology-constrained graph-walk actions. Instead of reasoning over a pre-selected neighbour set, CNY exposes lightweight neighbour previews and learns when to expand candidate neighbours for additional evidence. To address the delayed-credit challenge of neighbour exploration, we introduce destination-conditioned on-policy self-distillation, which retrospectively evaluates a selected neighbour after its content is revealed and converts the resulting change in action preference into an action-level training signal. Experiments on standard TAG reasoning benchmarks under a unified raw-text setting show that CNY consistently outperforms fixed-context post-training baselines. Furthermore, the learned exploration policy transfers to unseen graphs and to a graph-level task not encountered during training. Code is available at https://github.com/superallen13/CNY.
2608.29588.paper_summary_zh: 推理文本屬性圖（TAGs）需要大型語言模型（LLMs）將節點的文本與分佈在其鄰域的證據結合起來。現有的方法在生成之前固定可訪問的鄰居集，迫使推理在靜態上下文中運行，並防止模型在推理過程中獲取缺失的證據。我們認為鄰居選擇應該成為推理過程的一部分。為此，我們提出了自己呼叫鄰居（CNY），這是一個框架，使LLMs能夠通過拓撲約束的圖步驟行動主動探索圖鄰域。CNY不再在預選的鄰居集上進行推理，而是暴露輕量級的鄰居預覽，並學習何時擴展候選鄰居以獲取額外的證據。為了解決鄰居探索的延遲信用挑戰，我們引入了基於目的地的有政策自我蒸餾，該方法在選定的鄰居內容顯示後，回顧性地評估該鄰居，並將由此產生的行動偏好變化轉換為行動級訓練信號。在統一的原始文本設置下，對標準TAG推理基準的實驗顯示，CNY始終優於固定上下文的後訓練基準。此外，學習到的探索策略可以轉移到未見過的圖和訓練期間未遇到的圖級任務。代碼可在 https://github.com/superallen13/CNY 獲得。
